components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary download or decisive action with a contained telemetry glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 13px; color: #031218; background: #42d7ff; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(66, 215, 255, .18); font: 700 14px/1 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.01em; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1), background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #7be5ff; box-shadow: 0 14px 38px rgba(66, 215, 255, .25); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #42d7ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Panel-backed alternate action that remains visually quiet beside the primary path.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid rgba(154, 196, 224, .18); border-radius: 13px; color: #f4f9fc; background: #0b121b; font: 700 14px/1 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.01em; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1), background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(154, 212, 239, .34); background: #101a26; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #42d7ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Selected Segmented Control

components.css: .ds-segmented { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; border: 1px solid rgba(154, 212, 239, .34); border-radius: 10px; color: #f4f9fc; background: #101a26; box-shadow: 0 5px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, .2); font: 12px/1 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segmented small { color: #42d7ff; font: 800 8px/1 ui-monospace, 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-segmented:hover { background: #0b121b; } .ds-segmented:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #42d7ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-monitor { width: 284px; padding: 0 10px 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(154, 196, 224, .18); border-radius: 15px; color: #f8fbff; background: #0c121c; box-shadow: 0 20px 52px rgba(0, 0, 0, .46); font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-grip { height: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; } .ds-grip i { width: 3px; height: 3px; border-radius: 50%; background: #526579; } .ds-monitor header { padding: 6px 1px 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; } .ds-monitor header strong { font-size: 10px; } .ds-monitor header span { color: #8294a7; font-size: 7px; } .ds-monitor header span i { width: 5px; height: 5px; display: inline-block; border-radius: 50%; background: #57d6a1; } .ds-balance { padding: 13px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: end; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(154, 196, 224, .18); border-radius: 11px; background: #121d29; } .ds-balance small { grid-column: 1 / -1; color: #8294a7; font: 700 6px/1 ui-monospace, 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-balance b { font-size: 36px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.035em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-balance em { color: #91a3b5; font-size: 8px; font-style: normal; } .ds-progress { height: 5px; margin-top: 10px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(113, 140, 173, .18); } .ds-progress span { width: 64%; height: 100%; display: block; border-radius: inherit; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #2ed2ff, #5277ff); } .ds-monitor footer { margin-top: 6px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: #8294a7; font: 7px/1 ui-monospace, 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-rail { width: min(720px, 100%); margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); list-style: none; border-block: 1px solid rgba(154, 212, 239, .34); color: #f4f9fc; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rail li { min-height: 132px; padding: 25px 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-right: 1px solid rgba(154, 196, 224, .18); } .ds-rail li:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-rail b { margin-bottom: 24px; color: #42d7ff; font: 10px/1 ui-monospace, 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-rail strong { font-size: 15px; } .ds-rail span { margin-top: 5px; color: #9aabba; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.55; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-rail { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ds-rail li { min-height: 112px; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(154, 196, 224, .18); } .ds-rail li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } }

narrative.overview:
Credit Monitor renders product truth as a calm technical reading: a deep, desktop-first field of near-black surfaces where remaining credits, status, and proof are easier to inspect than to ignore. The world is precise rather than flashy—measurement ticks, concentric rings, tabular numerals, browser-window framing, and evidence rails make the landing page feel like a trustworthy operating surface.

Cyan is reserved for active telemetry and the primary path forward; green confirms healthy status. Layered panels, restrained glows, and fine blue-gray rules provide hierarchy without turning the page into a generic neon developer-tool landing page. The overall voice remains concise, technically credible, privacy-first, and explicit about limitations.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black instrument surfaces with fine blue-gray evidence lines.
Cyan active readings and actions; green only for confirmation or healthy status.
Variable sans headlines paired with tabular monospace labels and values.
Browser and workspace simulations treated as structured proof, not decoration.
Dense desktop evidence rails that stack cleanly into an explicit mobile sequence.

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Cyan identifies activity, selection, focus, progress, and the primary action; green identifies a healthy confirmation. Do not use either as broad decorative fill.

rules.name: The Evidence-Line Rule
rules.body: Prefer low-contrast rules and tonal shifts to hard card outlines. Strong rules frame only consequential rails, instruments, and permission proof.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Use monospace for values, labels, URLs, versions, code, and evidence metadata—not for explanatory paragraphs or campaign headlines.

rules.name: The Rail-First Rule
rules.body: Use a framed or divided rail for ordered proof and comparable facts; reserve broad open space for headings, hero copy, and the final call to action.

rules.name: The Contained Glow Rule
rules.body: Glows belong to the active control or telemetry marker they explain. Do not wash entire backgrounds or neutral cards in cyan.

rules.name: The Instrument Geometry Rule
rules.body: Use rounded rectangles for surfaces and controls, circles for status or measurement, and thin straight rules for sequence and evidence. Avoid ornamental diagonal clipping or exaggerated glass treatment.

dos: Do use the near-black surface stack and blue-gray evidence lines to separate information before introducing another card.
Do reserve cyan for active telemetry, focus, progress, selection, and the primary action; reserve green for a confirmed healthy result.
Do pair large balanced sans headlines with monospace labels, code, URLs, versions, and tabular values.
Do present product proof as bounded, ordered evidence rails or browser/workspace instruments.
Do preserve 44px minimum interactive targets and the observed reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't turn the landing page into a generic neon developer-tool interface or use cyan as an all-purpose background color.
Don't add broad ambient glows, frosted-glass effects, or decorative gradients that compete with telemetry.
Don't use green for calls to action or treat status confirmation as a general accent.
Don't replace the evidence rails with testimonial cards, browser-store badges, or unverified social proof.
Don't present fictional demo data or HTML/CSS walkthrough illustrations as live product or browser screenshots.
